title: 事象地平の雨と、擬似記憶の遺言
author: 鷹野 シン

en.title: Rain on the Horizon of Events, and the Will of Pseudo-Memory
en.premise: In a society where memories must be digitized and stored, a shop specializes in "damaged data" deemed irreparable. It opens only on "rainy days"—when the city’s electromagnetic noise spikes and the system’s surveillance network is compromised. The protagonist, a data restoration specialist, deciphers a fragmented "will" entrusted by a deceased individual, and in doing so confronts a physics paradox that shakes the very foundation of the city of Aegis.

zh.title: 事件地平线的雨与伪记忆的遗嘱
zh.premise: 在一个必须将记忆数字化并保存的社会里，有一家专门处理被判定为不可修复的“损坏数据”的店铺。该店只在“雨天”营业——那时城市的电磁噪声激增，系统的监控网络出现漏洞。主角是一名数据修复师，他在解读一位已故者托付的碎片化“遗嘱”时，发现了一种颠覆城市艾格斯存在根基的物理学矛盾。
